name: @gumag/cli
description: GUM (gum.ag by Jupiter) CLI & MCP server for people and AI agents: spot tokens, tokenized stocks, GUM Perps orderbooks/funding/trading, omnichain deposits & withdrawals across Solana, Base, Arbitrum, Ethereum, HyperEVM, BSC, Sui and Robinhood Chain.

scripts.lint: biome check --config-path ultracite.biome.jsonc src codegen apis/*/cli.ts package.json tsconfig.json ultracite.biome.jsonc server.json
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write --unsafe --config-path ultracite.biome.jsonc src codegen apis/*/cli.ts package.json tsconfig.json ultracite.biome.jsonc server.json
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run generate --check && bun run type-check && bun test && bun run build
scripts.sync-openapi: curl -fsSL https://api.gum.ag/app/v1/openapi.json -o apis/trading-api/openapi.json && bun run generate
